title: Scaling Inference Time Compute for Diffusion Models (Inference-Time Scaling beyond Denoising Steps)
tldr_zh: 把找好噪声形式化为 verifier × 搜索算法（random / zero-order / search-over-paths）设计空间，噪声搜索成为 test-time scaling 第二轴
tldr_en: Frames noise search as a verifier x search-algorithm design space (random, zero-order, search over paths), a second axis of diffusion inference-time scaling.
